item.title: Atlantic Ocean currents can recover from severe climate weakening, study finds
item.description: An Atlantic Ocean current system weakened by global warming could recover over time if the climate cools, a study by the Danish Meteorological Institute showed on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Agnieszka Olenska, Louise Rasmussen
item.content:encoded: An Atlantic Ocean current system weakened by global warming could recover over time if the climate cools, a study by the Danish Meteorological Institute showed on Wednesday. The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation brings warm water from the tropics northward toward the Arctic, and the flow of warm water helps keep Europe's winters mild. Published in the journal Science Advances, the study found no sign there was an irreversible tipping point for AMOC, as suggested by some previous studies, although the effects of the changes could last for centuries. However, it also said that the Greenland ice sheet that contributes to weakening the AMOC as it pours cold freshwater into the ocean could not be restored once it had melted — even if the warming trend was reversed. A disrupted AMOC could still destabilise global rainfall patterns and accelerate [USN:L6N3WM0K1 TEXT:"coastal sea-level rise"]. NO TIPPING POINT LEADING TO COLLAPSE SEEN IN MODEL The study said the AMOC could slow to about 6 million cubic metres of water per second from around 17 million at around 7 degrees Celsius of global warming. "In our model, we do not see a tipping point leading to a collapse. The AMOC gradually weakens, but we find that it also immediately regains its strength if global warming is reversed," lead author Chuncheng Guo said. However, he warned that even though recovery starts as soon as temperatures fall, it could take several centuries to finish, all while the effects of a weakened current would persist. The 7 C rise used in the modelling used for scientific interest is far beyond the current projections for the warming trend. The UN's environmental body said in September global temperature rises are set to exceed the key threshold of 1.5 C "within a few years". Governments committed to keeping temperature rises within 1.5 C to limit the impacts of extreme weather under the 2015 Paris Agreement. The cooling rate required to reverse the AMOC also exceeds what is considered realistic with current technology, Guo added, pointing to a limitation of the single-model study. Further testing against other models was also needed, the study said. Willem Huiskamp at the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, who was not involved in the study, said a more stable AMOC would be good news, but said he doubted the real-world current was as stable as some models suggested. The researchers estimated a long-term sea-level rise of around 20 cm from the melting of the Greenland ice sheet following a 1.5 C rise, and urged faster action to rein in emissions. "Instead of relying on the global cooling to happen, it's a much, much safer strategy to not have warming in the first place," Guo said.

item.title: Patriots open window for A.J. Brown; Christian Gonzalez also limited in return
item.description: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was a limited participant on Wednesday as the team opened his 21-day practice window.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was a limited participant on Wednesday as the team opened his 21-day practice window. Brown has been sidelined since sustaining a high-ankle sprain during the second half of the Patriots' 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the teams' season opener on Sept. 9. He went on injured reserve two days later and missed the team's last four games. Pro Bowl cornerback Christian Gonzalez also was limited after telling reporters before practice that he's ready to return to the field after missing two games due to a shoulder injury. "I'm good now, ready for Sunday," Gonzalez told reporters. The Patriots (3-2) host their AFC East rivals, the New York Jets (2-3), on Sunday. New England cornerbacks Carlton Davis III (neck) and Karon Prunty (hamstring) were the only players who did not practice, while quarterback Drake Maye (right shoulder) was a full participant. Brown and Gonzalez were among 13 players listed as limited, including running back TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and offensive tackles Will Campbell (knee) and Morgan Moses (foot). Gonzalez, 24, signed a four-year, $135 million contract extension last month. He has started all 37 career games in which he has played -- including three this season -- since being selected by New England with the 17th overall pick of the 2023 NFL Draft out of Oregon. As for Brown, he sustained his injury after he was targeted by a third-down pass from Maye, but Seahawks nickel cornerback Nehemiah Pritchett deflected the pass to force a punt. Pritchett's knee landed on the outside of Brown's ankle, which twisted inward as he went to the ground. Acquired from the Philadelphia Eagles via trade in early June, Brown had three receptions for a team-high 26 yards in the first half. Brown, 29, was named second-team All-Pro with the Eagles in 2022, 2023 and 2024. He has 527 receptions for 8,055 yards and 56 touchdowns in 106 career games (98 starts) with the Tennessee Titans (2019-21), Eagles (2022-25) and Patriots. --Field Level Media

WASHINGTON, Oct 14 : A group of Democratic lawmakers on Wednesday urged the Federal Aviation Administration to conduct a new environmental review before allowing an Amazon Prime Air drone delivery hub to be located about 30 miles (48.28 km) west of Boston. Massachusetts Democratic US Senators Ed Markey and Elizabeth Warren and Representatives Jim McGovern and Lori Trahan wrote to FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford seeking a new review after communities raised concerns about the planned Westborough hub and its impact on the environment and residents’ quality of life, including noise pollution, health and safety, and privacy. The FAA said it would respond directly to the lawmakers. Amazon did not immediately comment. Here are more details:

• On September 28, a group of 15 states and a Texas county on Monday sued the FAA over the agency's environmental review of planned commercial drone package delivery rules. • The agency in July issued a broad environmental review that allows qualifying drone operators to launch fleets without a site-specific environmental analysis. • The states — including New York, California, Massachusetts, Wisconsin and Michigan — and Harris County, Texas, said the FAA violated the law by failing to adequately analyze the potential environmental impacts of expanded drone package delivery operations. • Drone delivery operations are already happening in states including California, Texas, Arkansas, Florida and Utah under the waiver process. • The FAA said last year that eliminating the need for waivers "will significantly expand the use-case for drone technologies in areas like: manufacturing, farming, energy production, filmmaking, and the movement of products including lifesaving medications." • The FAA environmental review included reviewing the noise impacts of 1,150 average drone deliveries from a single hub. Drones would depart a hub and travel en route at an altitude of less than 400 feet (121 meters).

item.title: MLB adjusts Thursday start times for Championship Series games
item.description: The start time for Thursday's Game 3 of the American League Championship Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and Guardians has been moved up five hours due to forecasted rain in the Cleveland area.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The start time for Thursday's Game 3 of the American League Championship Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and Guardians has been moved up five hours due to forecasted rain in the Cleveland area. The game, initially scheduled to begin at 6 p.m. ET, will start at 1 p.m. ET, MLB announced Wednesday. Games 3, 4 and 5 of the series will be played over three consecutive days through Saturday at Progressive Field. "The change, which is based on forecasted rain on Thursday night in Cleveland, is being made proactively in order to remain on schedule in the ALCS," Major League Baseball said in a statement. MLB also changed the time of Game 4 of the National League Championship Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and host Los Angeles Dodgers on Thursday, moving the scheduled first pitch up one hour to 8 p.m. ET. "The change is a result of today's earlier modification to the start time of Game 3 of the (ALCS)," MLB announced. The Brewers hold a 2-0 lead in the best-of-seven series entering Game 3 on Wednesday in Los Angeles. As for Tampa Bay, it will send right-hander Griffin Jax (0-0, 4.50 ERA) to the mound to start Game 3. Cleveland has yet to announce its starting pitcher. The Rays evened the best-of-seven series with the Guardians at 1-1 with a 3-1 victory on Tuesday in St. Petersburg, Fla. The Guardians recorded a 7-3 victory in the series opener on Monday. --Field Level Media

item.title: South Africa revises rules around customisation of weight-loss drugs
item.description: South Africa is revising its rules governing the customisation of medicines, including sought-after GLP-1 treatments for diabetes and weight loss, health regulators said, warning pharmacies not to act as small-scale manufacturers.
item.dc:creator: Nqobile Dludla
item.content:encoded: South Africa is revising its rules governing the customisation of medicines, including sought-after GLP-1 treatments for diabetes and weight loss, health regulators said, warning pharmacies not to act as small-scale manufacturers. At a multi-stakeholder roundtable on counterfeit medicines on Wednesday, South African Pharmacy Council Registrar and CEO Vincent Tlala said the council was working with the South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (SAHPRA) on updated minimum standards and guidelines for compounding medicines. The revised standards are expected to go before the council in February, with publication targeted for March. Updated SAHPRA guidelines are expected to be released at the same time, Tlala said. The popularity of GLP-1 medicines such as Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) Ozempic and Wegovy and Eli Lilly's (LLY.N) Mounjaro and Zepbound has fuelled growth in compounded versions, drawing [USN:L8N43B1FF TEXT:"scrutiny"] from regulators [USN:L4N42O23Q TEXT:"globally"]. Compounding refers to the preparation of customised medicines by pharmacists for patients needing a variation to a commercially available product. Tlala said the council was concerned pharmacies were compounding medicines in anticipation of demand rather than for specific patients. "What we are seeing in the market, and which we are against, is when pharmacies become small-scale manufacturers," he said. Authorities are concerned that large-scale compounding may create openings for counterfeit medicines, particularly in high-demand categories such as weight-loss drugs. "There is a scourge of compounded products, especially in the area of weight-loss," Daphney Fafudi, SAHPRA's senior manager for market control, told Reuters on the sidelines. Fafudi said the updated guidelines from SAHPRA and revised minimum standards from the pharmacy council were intended to provide greater clarity on what is and is not permissible when compounding medicines. While existing regulations already contain provisions governing compounding, differing interpretations of those rules have led to disputes within the industry, including [USN:L1N42U0BN TEXT:"litigation"] involving local pharmaceutical compounding company iDexis and Novo Nordisk.

item.title: 米シティ、ＣＰＩ上振れでタカ派に転換 ＦＲＢの12月利上げ予想
item.description: [１４日 ロイター] - 米金融大手シティグループは１４日、９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回ったことを受け...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米シティ、ＣＰＩ上振れでタカ派に転換　ＦＲＢの12月利上げ予想 1:48 配信

米シティバンクのロゴ。2025年12月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[１４日　ロイター] - 米金融大手シティグループは１４日、９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回ったことを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月に政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げるとの見通しを示した。

シティは、ＦＲＢが１２月に利上げを実施した後、金利を据え置くとの見方を示した。また、利下げ開始は２０２７年６月までないと予想している。金融市場で１２月の利上げ確率が約９４％に達する中、同行はこれまで唯一、年内の追加利上げはないとの見方を維持してきた。

米労働省労働統計局が発表した９月のＣＰＩは前月比０．６％、前年比では３．７％上昇し、前月の０．４％と３．４％上昇から加速した。ガソリン価格の急騰を背景に伸びが加速した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、金利先物市場では、１０月２７─２８日に開かれる連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ確率は４７．１％と、ＣＰＩ発表前の約２２％から上昇した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/15(木) 1:48 ロイター

item.description: Oct 14 : Wall Street's biggest banks want to ride the AI wave without getting caught in its undertow, as the promise of a lucrative infrastructure boom collides with questions over returns and new security threats. Executives at the largest US banks this week discussed the risks of AI agents acting on custom

FAST

Oct 14 : Wall Street's biggest banks want to ride the AI wave without getting caught in its undertow, as the promise of a lucrative infrastructure boom collides with questions over returns and new security threats.  Executives at the largest US banks this week discussed the risks of AI agents acting on customers' behalf and the uncertainty surrounding demand for the capital and computing power needed to fuel the technology's rapid growth. "While we are proud of the privileged position we play in the AI investment cycle, no one knows how the demands for capital and compute will evolve as the broader AI ecosystem matures," Goldman CEO David Solomon said on a call with analysts. "That will only become clearer as technology and markets continue to develop. This uncertainty reinforces the importance of remaining vigilant around the types of activity we finance and how we manage risk."

Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser does not believe that higher rates will slow down the investment in the AI infrastructure. "We're not seeing a slowdown in investment in the broader AI ecosystem. There's simply not enough compute," she said, referring to the processing power needed to develop and run AI models, supported by chips and data centers. CAPITAL BEHIND THE GREAT AI BUILDOUT The scale of investment in AI infrastructure is unprecedented. Big Tech has committed billions to building data centers, the backbone of the computing capacity needed to train and run generative AI models. For Wall Street, the buildout offers a chance to finance one of the biggest investment cycles in decades. Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said the enormous amount of AI capital investment is important for the lender's investment-grade debt and leveraged finance businesses.    Yet the financing opportunity hinges on several unknowns, from whether demand for computing power will keep pace with the industry's ambitious expansion plans to the returns data center projects can generate and the potential for local opposition. "The AI investment cycle has become a complicated macroeconomic force in its own right," Wells Fargo CEO Charlie Scharf told analysts on a post-earnings call. He added that the buildout presents both opportunities and risks, given the significant leverage used to finance it and upward pressure on prices in some industries and supply chains. "Having said this, the strength of the economy and the positive forces from these investments have thus far outweighed the potential downside," Scharf said. Elevated interest rates that stay higher for longer, or rise further, could increase financing costs for data center projects, squeeze returns and make it more expensive for borrowers to service debt. Morgan Stanley Chief Financial Officer Sharon Yeshaya said in an interview with Reuters that the bank was "very discerning" about the types of risks it was taking. "What you worry about is that peers and other firms allow for a loosening of credit standards, and that's kind of what creates the issue. We're very focused on making sure that we're not involved in those types of transactions." The bank's CEO Ted Pick told analysts the involvement in AI financing is "existential" for Morgan Stanley. Investors, too, are weighing the economic benefits of the AI boom against the risk of losses on loans to projects that fail to deliver expected returns. "To the extent that the tech spend is helping drive growth in the overall economy, that is a positive and material to the banks. If the credit exposure is directly related to certain projects like speculative data-center builds, it could lead to issues down the road," said Macrae Sykes, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, which holds several bank stocks.  Other investors say that banks are better positioned to manage those risks than some fear, having tightened their risk management practices after the financial crisis. Dave Ellison, portfolio manager at Hennessy Funds, said banks have not abandoned the lessons of the crisis and are being more careful than investors fear. They are facilitating AI-related financing, but often as arrangers that distribute risk. RINGFENCING EMERGING AI RISKS  Beyond financing the buildout, banks are deploying AI in hopes of cutting costs and boosting productivity, but the financial payoff remains difficult to quantify.  "As important and dramatic and exciting as this theme is, it takes a long time to really do things that are visible at an institution of our size," JPMorgan CFO Jeremy Barnum said, adding that it is not a surprise that benefits are not yet observable in the bank's quarterly earnings. Citi's Fraser said the bank is already seeing clear effects of the use of AI, such as developing products at lower cost and up to 40 per cent faster. The use of coding tools has eased development and reduced tech vendor expenses by 30 per cent, she said. "We are seeing the financial benefits from AI and automation significantly outweigh the investments we've made year to date," Fraser said. The bank is using AI to reduce the volume of manual processes, as well as response time in client service.  Investors are betting on AI to deliver productivity gains across corporate America and valuations of US stocks leave little room for those gains to disappoint. "If those gains in productivity and lower costs do not arrive by the end of next year, investors will begin to question the hype of AI," Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, said.  At the same time, AI agents introduce new security challenges as they gain the ability to act autonomously. The technology is also adding to the threat posed by external cyber attackers. JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said that the lender is developing tools to navigate agentic AI risk.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's top data centre in attack on AI ambitions
item.description: The attack follows a series of Ukrainian strikes on Russian data centres.
item.dc:creator: CNA

Ukrainian drones hit Russia's top data centre in attack on AI ambitions

The attack follows a series of Ukrainian strikes on Russian data centres.

A man walks outside an office building housing a branch of Russia's largest bank Sberbank in Moscow, Russia, Dec 5, 2025. (Photo: REUTERS/Ramil Sitdikov)

FAST

MOSCOW: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's biggest data centre on Wednesday (Oct 14), part of a series of attack s appearing to target Moscow's ambitions to develop Russian artificial intelligence capabilities on a par with those from the US and China. The strike on the Balakovo data centre , owned by Sberbank, the country's largest bank and technology company, followed three attack s in the past week on data centre s owned by Russian technology group Yandex. "We confirm that the data processing centre was attack ed. At the same time, all of Sberbank's systems and services are operating normally and without disruption," Sberbank First Deputy CEO Alexander Vedyakhin told reporters. Russian President Vladimir Putin held a previously unannounced meeting on Wednesday with top officials on "information security", in which Sberbank CEO German Gref took part. The Kremlin s ai d that the meeting was not linked to the attack s on data centre s. Russia's state RIA Novosti news agency reported in 2024 that the Sberbank centre hit on Wednesday would host Russia's biggest supercomputer, which is scheduled to go into operation in 2027.

The Yandex data centre s, hit earlier, hosted all three of that company's operating supercomputers. Neither Yandex nor Sberbank has s ai d whether supercomputers, used to tr ai n the AI models, were damaged in the Ukrainian attack s. Along with Yandex, its m ai n domestic rival, Sberbank is Russia's leading developer of artificial intelligence. The domestic market is shared between Sberbank's GigaChat model and YandexGPT.

DIFFICULTIES PURCHASING CHIPS Both companies have invested heavily in the development of their models but lag global leaders in the United States and China by up to nine months, according to Sberbank's own estimates, partly due to Western sanctions which hinder Russia's access to the most advanced hardware. "It's clear what difficulties we face when purchasing modern graphics processing units. Both we and Yandex suffer from this," Gref s ai d on Sep 29, calling it the biggest reason why Russia lags behind the US and China in AI . Sberbank is in talks to buy chips from Chinese makers, but in an interview with Reuters on Jun 3, Vedyakhin s ai d that US chipmaker Nvidia's NVDA.O monopoly on its CUDA software platform, which has become an AI industry standard, is an even greater problem. Yandex s ai d previously that its supercomputers operated on Nvidia A100 chips, a model launched in 2020 and since then succeeded by more advanced H100 chips. Sberbank has two functioning supercomputers. The most advanced one, called Christofari Neo, ranked 167th in the Top 500 list of the world's most powerful supercomputers, is located in Moscow and is based on Nvidia A100 chips. Yandex's most advanced Chervonenkis supercomputer is ranked 101st in the same list. IT expert Mikh ai l Klimarev told Reuters it could take a long time to replace the chips due to Western sanctions, while damage to the supercomputers could set back the Russian AI industry, which already suffered from sanctions. "The equipment is being imported, but it's done at a high cost, through indirect routes. First, you need to negotiate so that someone is willing to sell it to you and is not afr ai d of sanctions," he s ai d.

Related:

Heavy Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 6, cut power in Kyiv

NATO general sets out tough military response to any 'foolish' Russian attack

PROTECT ASSETS Some commentators compared the lack of reported disruption at state-controlled Sberbank with Yandex - whose taxi and food delivery units had reported disruptions - saying it showed that Sberbank's centre s are better protected. "This is a great example of what a business owner can do to protect their assets," wrote military blogger Alexander Kots. Under an August decree by Putin, the state can take over administration of poorly protected facilities. The Sberbank site is located close to the Balakovo nuclear power plant, which the data centre uses as an energy source, and the Saratov hydroelectric power plant. No damage was reported to either plant from the attack . Ukr ai ne says it is responding to Russian attack s on its own data sites. Both countries have attack ed each other's refineries, power stations, ports and e-commerce companies. Russia's digital development ministry s ai d this week it was in talks with the military on protecting the data centre s, while some lawmakers called for them to be moved underground where the hardware will be out of reach for drones . "We need a so-called Doomsday data vault," Valery Yermakov, deputy CEO of state-controlled Rostelecom, another major data centre operator, told a conference in Moscow.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: Monedas caen tras dato inflación en EEUU que reaviva expectativas de alza de tasas
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina cayeron el miércoles, en medio de un avance global del dólar tras un dato de la inflación en Estados Unidos que reavivó las expectativas de una posible nueva alza de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina cayeron el miércoles, en medio de un avance global del dólar tras un dato de la inflación en Estados Unidos que reavivó las expectativas de una posible nueva alza de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. * [USN:L6N4600VI TEXT:"Los precios al consumidor"] en Estados Unidos se aceleraron en septiembre por un repunte de la gasolina, en un nuevo revés para el presidente Donald Trump y su Partido Republicano antes de las elecciones legislativas del 3 de noviembre. * Tras este dato, que también reveló una inflación subyacente más alta de lo que habían previsto los economistas, la probabilidad implícita de un alza de tasas en la reunión que celebrará la Fed del 27 y 28 de octubre se elevó hasta alrededor del 46%, desde un 22% antes del informe. * El mes pasado, la Fed elevó su tasa de interés de referencia a un día en 25 puntos básicos, situándola en el rango del 3,75% al 4,00%, la primera subida en tres años, y señaló que habría nuevas alzas de los costos de financiación en los próximos meses. * El índice dólar , que mide al billete verde frente a una canasta de seis importantes monedas, escaló alrededor de un 0,35% y volvió a tocar máximos de 18 meses. * El peso mexicano llegó a debilitarse hasta 18,5500 unidades por dólar, un nivel no visto desde noviembre del año pasado, aunque posteriormente moderó sus pérdidas y cerró en 18,4888 unidades, con un declive del 0,71%. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, bajaba un 0,26%, a 66.792,64 unidades, tras cuatro jornadas de ganancias. * El real brasileño se depreció un 0,14%, a 5,0298 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo retrocedió un 0,23%, a 206.401,67 puntos. * [USN:L6N4600Y1 TEXT:"La actividad del sector de servicios"] de Brasil se contrajo un 0,1% en agosto respecto del mes anterior, según datos de la agencia de estadística IBGE, lo que se suma a los indicios de desaceleración de la mayor economía de América Latina. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista quedó equilibrado en la zona de los 1.513,5 por cada dólar , un día después de que se informara una inflación (IPC) del 1,9% en septiembre, desde el 1,7% de agosto, un dato que estuvo en línea a lo previsto por especialistas. * Analistas no descartan que la economía argentina haya entrado en recesión en el tercer trimestre, aunque se proyecta una lenta recuperación a medida que el país se acerque a las elecciones presidenciales del 2027, según una encuesta de Reuters. * Ante un riesgo país ligeramente complejo ya que nuevamente se mueve cerca de los 610 puntos básicos, la bolsa de Buenos Aires (.MERV) cedió un 1,16% y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles cayeron un 1,2% promedio ante esperadas toma de utilidades de corto alcance. * El peso chileno , cayó un 0,36%, a 985,00/985,30 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , bajó un 0,49%, a 10.966,21 puntos. * El peso colombiano terminó con baja de un 0,04% a 3.183,80 unidades por dólar, mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) finalizó con un alza del 0,46% a 2.582,29 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,06% a 3,4380/3,4390 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdía un 0,98% a 1.571,55 puntos.

item.title: Baicha Baidao notes Hong Kong regulator's trading suspension over IPO rigging concerns
item.description: China's Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial on Wednesday noted the Hong Kong securities regulator's decision to suspend trading over concerns its initial public offering demand may have been rigged.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial (2555.HK) on Wednesday noted the Hong Kong securities regulator's decision to suspend trading over concerns its initial public offering demand may have been rigged. Here are some details: The Securities and Futures Commission directed the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on Tuesday to suspend the Chinese tea shop chain's H shares, citing "serious concerns" about artificial demand for the IPO. "We are acting decisively to protect investors and uphold the integrity of Hong Kong's markets," SFC Executive Director of Enforcement Michael Duignan said. The company, which raised about $330 million in its 2024 Hong Kong debut, said it is seeking legal advice and will work to address and resolve the SFC's concerns. It said that business operations remain normal as of October 14. IPOs and other share sales have become a key regulatory focus this year, with banks and advisers urged to "consider market capacity and choose quality issuers while exercising robust internal control," according to [USN:L8N4520JP TEXT:"two sources"] who spoke to Reuters in September. The sources added that Hong Kong's securities watchdog has also guided investment banks on how to cooperate during regulatory raids.

item.title: México obliga a plataformas digitales a proteger a menores de contenidos nocivos
item.description: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, firmó el miércoles un decreto que obliga a las plataformas digitales a proteger a los niños y adolescentes de contenidos violentos, sexuales y de otras conductas de riesgo, una medida que podría abrir un nuevo frente de regulación para las grandes empresas tecnológicas en uno de los mayores mercados de internet de América Latina.
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré, Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, firmó el miércoles un decreto que obliga a las plataformas digitales a proteger a los niños y adolescentes de contenidos violentos, sexuales y de otras conductas de riesgo, una medida que podría abrir un nuevo frente de regulación para las grandes empresas tecnológicas en uno de los mayores mercados de internet de América Latina. Las plataformas deberán impedir que menores tengan acceso o sean expuestos a contenidos vinculados con discursos de odio, extremismo, abuso, explotación o violencia sexual, suicidio, trastornos alimenticios, acoso y conductas ilícitas, entre otros, según el decreto. "Las plataformas estuvieron de acuerdo, lo único que pidieron fue un mes para poder prepararse para que esto sea una realidad", dijo Sheinbaum en su conferencia de prensa matutina antes de firmar la resolución. El plazo fue acordado en conversaciones entre funcionarios y representantes de Meta, Microsoft, Apple, TikTok, Google, X y Huawei, con los que se consensuó el contenido del decreto, detalló la consejera jurídica de la Presidencia, Luisa María Alcalde. Apple, Microsoft, X, TikTok, Alphabet (propietario de Google y YouTube) y Huawei no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. "Es obligatorio (el decreto), mas no punitivo, pero creemos que va a ser muy útil", explicó Alcalde. Sin embargo, Sheinbaum agregó que si las empresas no cumplen con las medidas señaladas, el Gobierno publicará una ley que implicará sanciones para ellas. La iniciativa fue anunciada originalmente a principios de octubre, luego que un [USN:L6N45N132 TEXT:"ataque en una escuela"] secundaria en el estado norteño Coahuila dejara un fallecido y tres heridos. Además, forma parte de una estrategia más amplia del gobierno de Sheinbaum para promover entornos digitales seguros para menores. Funcionarios han dicho que las empresas deberán desarrollar mecanismos para identificar y retirar contenidos prohibidos, clasificar materiales por edad, reforzar controles parentales y mantener canales de contacto con autoridades. Un portavoz de Meta (matriz de Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp y Threads) dijo a Reuters que la empresa está "al tanto del anuncio" y que "lo analizarían a detalle", y agregó que desde hace años cuentan con herramientas para que madres y padres acompañen "la experiencia digital de sus hijos". Meta comentó que, además, ofrecen mecanismos de seguridad en sus plataformas como "cuentas de adolescentes en Facebook e Instagram que incluyen protecciones para limitar quién puede contactarlos y el contenido que ven". La propuesta coloca a México en línea con una tendencia internacional hacia una mayor supervisión de las plataformas digitales. En los últimos años, gobiernos de la Unión Europea, Reino Unido, Australia y varios estados de Estados Unidos han impulsado normas para proteger a los menores en internet, exigiendo mayores controles sobre algoritmos, moderación de contenidos y verificación de edad. Iniciativas similares han surgido en América Latina, donde países como Brasil y Colombia han avanzado debates regulatorios para reforzar la protección de menores y exigir mayores responsabilidades a las plataformas digitales. Sin embargo, iniciativas similares han generado debates sobre los límites entre la protección de menores, la privacidad y la libertad de expresión. Sheinbaum ha dicho que el objetivo es responsabilizar a las empresas por los contenidos que difunden a menores y no promover la censura. La atención de inversionistas y expertos del sector estará puesta en la implementación del decreto, incluyendo los mecanismos de cumplimiento y la eventual respuesta de las empresas implicadas. Cualquier endurecimiento regulatorio podría convertirse en un precedente para futuras normas sobre seguridad digital y contenido en México, el segundo mercado de internet más grande de América Latina después de Brasil.

item.title: Dólar toca máximo en 18 meses, luego cede ciertas alzas ya que inversores apuestas por una Fed paciente
item.description: El dólar tocó el miércoles su máximo en 18 meses, luego de que datos de inflación superiores a lo esperado reavivaran brevemente las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal este mes, pero la moneda luego se dio un respiro ya que los inversores volvieron a la creencia de que la Fed será paciente.
item.dc:creator: Laura Matthews
item.content:encoded: El dólar tocó el miércoles su máximo en 18 meses, luego de que datos de inflación superiores a lo esperado reavivaran brevemente las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal este mes, pero la moneda luego se dio un respiro ya que los inversores volvieron a la creencia de que la Fed será paciente. La Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales del Departamento de Trabajo informó el miércoles de que los precios al consumidor en Estados Unidos subieron considerablemente en septiembre debido al fuerte repunte de los precios de la gasolina. El índice dólar , que mide la fortaleza del billete verde frente a una cesta de seis divisas, subió un 0,34%, a 102,53 unidades, después de cotizar previamente hasta los 102,94 puntos. El informe eclipsó las recientes señales moderadas de los responsables de la Fed, incluidos los comentarios del presidente de la Fed de Nueva York, John Williams, que debilitaron al dólar el martes. La vicepresidenta de Supervisión de la Fed, Michelle Bowman, también señaló un enfoque de esperar y ver antes de subir nuevamente el costo del crédito. Mientras, el Libre Beige del banco central estadounidense mostró el miércoles que el mercado laboral se mantenía en patrón de baja contratación y bajos despidos, mientras que las presiones inflacionarias aumentaron en partes del país. Los operadores estiman ahora que hay un 65% de probabilidades de que la Fed mantenga las tasas sin cambios en su reunión del 27 al 28 de octubre, frente al 53% de hace un mes, mientras que descuentan un endurecimiento de unos 79 puntos básicos para finales de 2027, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME Group. El banco central estadounidense subió el mes pasado su tasa de interés de referencia en un cuarto de punto porcentual, al rango del 3,75%-4,00%. El euro cayó un 0,41%, a 1,1152 dólares, alcanzando un mínimo de 17 meses frente al dólar y un piso 16 meses frente a la libra esterlina, ya que la subida de los precios del petróleo y las persistentes preocupaciones sobre la salud fiscal de Francia seguían lastrando a la moneda única. La libra esterlina bajó un 0,59%, a 1,3177 dólares. El yen japonés cedió un 0,08%, a 158,16 por dólar.

item.title: Televisa’s AT&T Mexico deal boosts its challenge to America Movil
item.description: Shares in Televisa rose on Wednesday after the Mexican broadcaster said it would buy AT&T's Mexican unit, in a move welcomed by investors that will set up a showdown with telecoms giant America Movil .
item.dc:creator: Paolo Laudani
item.content:encoded: Shares in Televisa (TLEVISACPO.MX) rose on Wednesday after the Mexican broadcaster said [USN:L4N45Z226 TEXT:"it would buy"] AT&T's Mexican unit, in a move welcomed by investors that will set up a showdown with telecoms giant America Movil (AMXB.MX) . The acquisition, if completed, would significantly expand Televisa’s telecom footprint, with Scotiabank analysts estimating its share of Mexico’s fixed and wireless subscribers would more than double to 19% from 8%. The increase in scale would strengthen Televisa’s position in a market dominated by America Movil, controlled by the family of Mexican billionaire Carlos Slim. However, analysts cautioned that integrating the new business and competing in Mexico’s costly, fiercely contested telecom sector could limit the benefits of the deal. Televisa could become a stronger rival, with more growth opportunities, by selling service bundles and earning more from its existing customers, analysts at UBS said. "We believe the transaction could be positive for the Mexican telecom industry. Consolidation usually leads to a greater focus on profitability, returns and cash generation," analysts at UBS said. The deal, worth $2 billion in cash and done in tandem with privately held Fintech Holdings, pushed shares up around 6% at 1944 GMT. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027. Investors aren't likely to expect major gains until the combined company delivers on expected results. EXECUTION RISKS The valuation represents a significant discount to comparable telecom companies in Latin America, but the acquisition carries some execution risks, Santander analysts wrote in a note. "Value will be created through turning around AT&T Mexico’s operations which have historically struggled (low margins) and eventually build out a convergent fixed-mobile offering ... which could also prove challenging," the note said. UBS also flagged execution as a challenge ahead for the new group. AT&T Mexico still requires network modernization and investment, particularly in 5G, and the deal's success will depend on THE management's ability to improve the network while generating cash, the bank said. Santander analysts expected little immediate effect on America Movil, citing its scale and dominant market position. Scotiabank, however, said the deal could intensify competitive pressure because the relatively low purchase price could allow Televisa and Fintech to devote more capital to network investment.

item.title: ホルムズ海峡付近で貨物船2隻沈没、過去24時間に相次ぎ被弾
item.description:
Jonathan Saul Renee Maltezou
[ロンドン １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jonathan Saul　Renee Maltezou

[ロンドン １４日 ロイター] - 海事安全保障関係筋は１４日、コンテナ船とばら積み貨物船の計２隻が過去２４時間以内に、別々の攻撃でそれぞれ飛来物に被弾し、ホルムズ海峡付近で沈没したと明らかにした。

イランは、米国によるイランの港湾封鎖と９月の制裁強化への対抗措置として、攻撃を強化していると説明している。ＩＭＯの海難データの分析によると、今回の２隻を含め、２月２８日の米・イラン戦争開始以降に沈没した商船は計３隻となった。

同海峡周辺での攻撃は過去１０日間で急増している。

沈没したうちの１隻はシンガポール船籍の小型コンテナ船「ＧＦＳプライド」。シンガポール海事港湾庁（ＭＰＡ）は１４日の声明で「ＧＦＳプライドは損傷を受け、船上で火災が発生した後、沈没した。乗組員２１人全員が無事に退避し、負傷者の報告はない」と述べた。同船は１３日に海峡を航行していたという。積載能力は２０フィートコンテナ換算で２８２４個（ＴＥＵ）。

別の事案では、アンティグア・バーブーダ船籍のばら積み貨物船「ケープダオ」が、９月２３日に飛来物に被弾してから数週間後、海峡近くで沈没した。国連の国際海事機関（ＩＭＯ）が１４日に示したデータで明らかになった。

海事関係筋によると、乗組員１人が死亡し、残る乗組員は攻撃直後に退避した。

アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）を拠点とする同船の管理会社ピオニーズ・シップマネジメントＦＺＥからのコメントは直ちに得られなかった。

海事リスク管理会社ＭＡＲＩＳＫＳは１４日、「今回の事案は、ホルムズ海峡を通航する商船への脅威が続いていることを改めて示している」と指摘。「脅威はタンカーに限らず、コンテナ船やばら積み貨物船も深刻な損傷を受けている」と述べた。

＜イランが支配強化＞

ホルムズ海峡とその周辺で商船への脅威が急速に高まり、同海峡の安全を巡る懸念が強まっている。紛争前は世界の原油と液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の貿易量の約５分の１が同海峡を通過していた。

イランは２月２８日の米国とイスラエルによる攻撃以降、同海峡の支配強化を図ってきた。米政府に対する交渉力を得ようと、船舶の通航を制限している。

イラン政府高官２人がロイターに語ったところによると、イランは原油価格を高水準に維持し、米中間選挙に影響を及ぼそうと、同海峡を航行する船舶に対して新たな手法を次々と展開している。

イランと米国はタンカーを中心に攻撃しているが、貨物船やコンテナ船も攻撃を受け、航行不能になったり沈没したりしている。

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 14 : The Knot Worldwide has agreed to buy its smaller peer Zola, adding to its portfolio of leading wedding-planning brands, according to two people familiar with the deal.  The Knot, which is owned by investment firm Permira, helps couples find local wedding vendors and create personalized wedding websites.  Zola offers similar services such as wedding and registry sites, invitation design and guest-list management. Zola will continue to operate as a standalone brand within The Knot's portfolio of global brands, the people said.  The companies and Permira declined to comment. Financial terms of the deal were not immediately available.

The Knot launched in the 1990s and Permira has been invested in it since 2018. Last year, the company appointed outsider and former Etsy executive Raina Moskowitz as its CEO to help reorganize the business and launch new AI tools in the face of rapid technological transformation. This year, for example, it launched an app within ChatGPT, which it called the first of its kind within the wedding industry.  Zola launched in 2013 and raised $100 million in a Series D financing round in 2018 at a reported valuation of around $600 million. That round was led by existing investor Comcast Ventures, with new investors NBCUniversal and Goldman Sachs Investment Partners also participating. Zola's co-founders Shan-Lyn Ma and Nobu Nakaguchi remained significant owners.  Zola will become the 14th brand in The Knot's portfolio. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, including any required regulatory clearances, the people said.

item.title: 軽油不足、27年まで続く公算 中東情勢・ロシア製油所被害で＝ＩＥＡ
item.description:
Robert Harvey
[ロンドン １４日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は１４日、中東緊迫化やロシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
軽油不足、27年まで続く公算　中東情勢・ロシア製油所被害で＝ＩＥＡ 0:34 配信

９月２８日、米カリフォルニア州で撮影　REUTERS/Fred Greaves

Robert Harvey

[ロンドン １４日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は１４日、中東緊迫化やロシアの製油所への攻撃で石油生産が抑制される中、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）の供給のひっ迫が２０２７年まで続く可能性があるとの見方を示した。月報で「過去最高水準の軽油価格は、実質所得や企業活動、インフレなどに影響を及ぼし、経済的影響が広がっている」と指摘した。

９月の中東とロシアからの軽油輸出は合計で日量１３０万バレル減少した。２６年末に向けて製油所の操業が回復し、在庫の補充が始まると予想するものの、軽油やジェット燃料などの減少分を補うのには不十分だと見ている。

軽油は産業分野や農業、輸送など使用範囲が広い。価格高騰に伴う政治的な圧力が高まる中、ＩＥＡ加盟国は価格抑制のため、石油と軽油計1億バレルの備蓄放出に向けた調整を進めている。

ＩＥＡによる２６年の世界の石油需要見通しは日量２６０万バレル減で、うち２５％を軽油が占める。これに対し、供給量は日量５８０万バレル減少し、２７年には日量７７０万バレル増に転じると見込んでいる。

ＩＥＡは今年３月に最大４億バレルの石油備蓄の協調放出を主導した。ただ９月の放出ペースは日量約２７万バレルと、３─６月平均の日量２２０万バレルから減少した。９月末時点での放出量は合計で３億３１００万バレル。欧州の４６００万バレルなどは未放出のままだ。

湾岸産油国からの原油輸出は９月に日量４４０万バレル増え、イラン交戦前の水準の約７５％となったものの、足元の攻撃激化により、回復が阻害される恐れがある。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：イラン戦争の供給減吸収した石油市場、在庫払底で価格急騰リスク残る アングル：企業決算で株高機運に冷水か、混迷の中東情勢　ガイダンスリスク警戒 アングル：日銀4月利上げシナリオ複雑に、市場との対話も難題　中東情勢長期化で 焦点：成熟期の豪債券市場、記録的発行ラッシュが中東情勢で試練に アングル：中東情勢でアジア経済に試練　燃料高と通貨安で苦渋の政策選択へ 最終更新: 10/15(木) 0:34 ロイター

item.title: ネットフリックス、全従業員の6％・1000人削減へ 22年以来の規模
item.description:
Prathik Jayaprakash Anzar Mehraj
[１４日 ロイター] - 米動画配信大手ネットフリ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ネットフリックス、全従業員の6％・1000人削減へ　22年以来の規模 0:26 配信

2026年2月3日撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

Prathik Jayaprakash　Anzar Mehraj

[１４日 ロイター] - 米動画配信大手ネットフリックスが、全従業員の６％に相当する約１０００人を削減する。ロイターが入手した社内メモで明らかになった。人員削減は２０２２年以来の規模となる。

グレッグ・ピーターズ、テッド・サランドス両共同最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１４日に社員に送った電子メールによると、人員削減の大部分は製品、技術、法務、人事の各部門が対象となる。

ネットフリックス株は年初来で約２５％下落しているが、１４日は０．７％上昇した。２０２５年末時点の従業員数は約１万６０００人だった。

ユーチューブや「ＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）」といったプラットフォームが、無料で視聴可能なユーザー生成コンテンツで視聴者を引きつけており、ネットフリックスに対してコスト面で優位に立っている。さらに、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリーの配信・スタジオ資産買収が失敗に終わったことで、ネットフリックスの戦略に対する懸念がさらに深まった。

調査会社イーマーケッターのシニアアナリスト、ロス・ベネス氏は「ネットフリックスは別の主要な収益源を見つけられていない」と指摘。「最終的には、サブスクリプションが頭打ちに近づいているため、収益を多様化する別の収益源が必要になるだろう。だが、そこで苦戦が続いている」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：「ウォール街」と実体経済の温度差、ＡＩブームで一層鮮明に アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か アングル：ネットフリックス、ワーナー買収失敗でオリジナル作品に注力 最終更新: 10/15(木) 0:26 ロイター

item.title: ネタニヤフ氏、総選挙前のイラン先制攻撃に慎重姿勢 「得策ではない」
item.description: [エルサレム １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[エルサレム　１４日　ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は１４日、同国で１０月２７日に予定される総選挙を前にイランへの先制攻撃を実施することには賛成しないとの見解を示した。一方で、イランとその代理勢力に対し、イスラエルへの攻撃を行わないよう警告した。

ネタニヤフ氏はイスラエル陸軍放送のインタビューで、先制攻撃の可能性や、選挙を前に軍事衝突を画策しているとする政敵からの批判について問われ、「われわれにとって都合が良くないし、得策ではない」とし、先制攻撃に慎重な姿勢を示した。

また、「イランがわれわれにミサイルを発射したとしても、彼らは私を非難するだろう」と述べる一方、攻撃を受ければイスラエルは強力に反撃するとし、イランに対するこれまでの警告を繰り返した。

選挙後の先制攻撃の可能性や、イランを巡る米政府との最近の協議内容については、詳細を明らかにしなかった。

イスラエルとイランは６月以降、攻撃の応酬を行っていない。

イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃に対し、イスラエルがサウジアラビアを支援しているかとの質問には、「私はそうした問題には関与しない。ただ言えるのは、われわれの大きな成功と目覚ましい成果を受け、中東の多くの国々がわれわれに目を向け始めているということだ」と述べた。

item.title: OpenAI employee who left for Apple took files about unreleased device, OpenAI alleges
item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 14 : An OpenAI employee who left the ChatGPT maker for Apple sent more than 100 files about an unreleased product to a personal account and later made a presentation about the unreleased product to senior Apple leadership, a new filing in the lawsuit between OpenAI and Apple alleges.In the filin

OpenAI employee who left for Apple took files about unreleased device, OpenAI alleges

Apple and OpenAI logos are seen in this illustration taken July 12, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 14 : An OpenAI employee who left the ChatGPT maker for Apple sent more than 100 files about an unreleased product to a personal account and later made a presentation about the unreleased product to senior Apple leadership, a new filing in the lawsuit between OpenAI and Apple alleges. In the filing in US federal court in San Jose, California, OpenAI alleged that the presentation happened months ago and that Apple is now making AI products of its own, citing the release of Apple's HomeView product this week. "OpenAI is very concerned that its trade secret and confidential information is now circulating inside Apple, where Apple engineers can shape Apple’s upcoming products based on OpenAI’s confidential and innovative work," OpenAI said in its filing. Apple said that it has policies and procedures in place to ensure new employees do not use confidential information from previous employers and that it has found no evidence to support OpenAI's allegations.

The document, filed on Tuesday, is part of an ongoing trade secret dispute filed by Apple earlier this year in which it alleged employees of the iPhone maker left and took confidential information to OpenAI's hardware division. OpenAI has denied those allegations. Earlier this week, US District Court Judge Edward Davila granted part of Apple's request to get early access to digital files from OpenAI in the suit. Davila said Apple could gather data from some of its former employees' devices and sit three of them for depositions on a sped-up schedule, including the two defendants in the case — Chang Liu, a former senior system electrical engineer, and Tang Yew Tan, a former vice president of product design for iPhone and Apple Watch. The case is likely to go to trial in October 2027, though OpenAI has said in court filings that it could be ready for trial as soon as June 2027.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Nasdaq cierra con fuerte baja por expectativas de alzas de tasas tras dato de inflación
item.description: Datos de inflación más altos de lo esperado provocaron una fuerte caída del Nasdaq el miércoles, ya que el temor a nuevas alzas de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal golpeó a las acciones de Oracle, CoreWeave y otras empresas del sector de la inteligencia artificial (IA) sensibles al aumento de los costos de financiación.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: Datos de inflación más altos de lo esperado provocaron una fuerte caída del Nasdaq el miércoles, ya que el temor a nuevas alzas de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal golpeó a las acciones de Oracle, CoreWeave y otras empresas del sector de la inteligencia artificial (IA) sensibles al aumento de los costos de financiación. El aumento de las apuestas a que la Fed subirá aún más las tasas para frenar la inflación asestó un duro golpe a algunas de las firmas que más habían subido en el mercado en 2026. Oracle (ORCL.N) , CoreWeave (CRWV.O) y Nebius (NBIS.O) se desplomaron. Dell (DELL.N) y Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) se hundieron después de que Barclays bajó su recomendación para los fabricantes de servidores de IA de "sobreponderar" a "ponderación neutra". El índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) cayó por sexta sesión seguida, su racha bajista más larga desde mayo de 2025. Los precios al consumidor en Estados Unidos se aceleraron en septiembre debido al fuerte repunte del precio de la gasolina y a que las presiones inflacionarias se extendieron fuera del sector energético, según datos de la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales del Departamento de Trabajo. Los operadores de tasas de interés descuentan una probabilidad del 37% de que los responsables de la política monetaria de la Fed suban las tasas este mes, frente al 22% del martes, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME. "Los inversores no están contentos con el informe porque esto ejerce presión sobre la Fed para que suba las tasas con el fin de combatir la inflación", dijo Adam Sarhan, presidente ejecutivo de 50 Park Investments, en Nueva York. "La inflación sigue siendo el enemigo público número uno para el mercado y para la Fed". Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 83,96 puntos, o un 1,08%, a 7.721,49 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) bajó 502,90 puntos, o un 1,85%, a 26.701,48 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 45,23 puntos, o un 0,09%, a 51.624,87 unidades. Tras alcanzar un máximo histórico la semana pasada, el S&P 500 sigue con un alza superior al 12% en 2026, impulsada en su mayor parte por los valores relacionados con la inteligencia artificial. La mediana de las acciones del S&P 500 ha subido un 4% en 2026, y más de 200 de los componentes del índice se encuentran en territorio negativo. Bank of America (BAC.N) cerró con una baja. Las ganancias del banco descendieron en el tercer trimestre, ya que destinó 1.200 millones de dólares a cubrir multas regulatorias por no haber detectado posibles casos de blanqueo de capitales. Morgan Stanley (MS.N) también bajó, a pesar del aumento de sus beneficios trimestrales. El índice de bancos del S&P 500 (.SPXBK) cayó a su nivel más bajo en más de cuatro meses.

ROME, Oct 14 : Chinese automakers looking to expand production capacity in Europe have ruled out Italy because of a lack of suitable factories, Italian industry minister Adolfo Urso said on Wednesday.  Chinese producers are looking to establish manufacturing plants inside the European Union as Brussels works on rules that will set minimum local content limits for electric vehicles sold in the bloc.  "They are touring Europe and what are they asking for? A turnkey factory," Urso told lawmakers in Rome, referring to a production site that would be ready to operate immediately. He said Chinese auto industry representatives, including BYD's European adviser Alfredo Altavilla, had visited plants in Italy and met Urso several times without finding suitable locations.

This was because Stellantis, Italy's sole major auto producer, has decided to produce cars in partnership with Chinese companies rather than give up any of its Italian factories, Urso said. "Stellantis, unlike other industry players, has not closed any plants in Italy and therefore has no turnkey facilities available to hand over to Chinese automakers," the minister said during a parliamentary questions session.  Altavilla told Reuters last month that BYD, unlike some of its Chinese competitors, aimed to buy and fully own a European plant rather than share it with local partners, adding that it was focusing on Spain and France.

item.title: Bank of America consumer retail M&A banker Peacock to join JPMorgan, sources say
item.description: JPMorgan Chase is hiring senior consumer and retail M&A banker Richard Peacock from Bank of America , four people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss, Abigail Summerville
item.content:encoded: JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) is hiring senior consumer and retail M&A banker Richard Peacock from Bank of America (BAC.N) , four people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday. Peacock, who joined Bank of America over a decade ago, will take the role of global head of consumer and retail M&A at JPMorgan early next year and be based in New York, said the people, who work in the financial industry and were not authorized to speak about his move publicly. He is the [USN:L1N45Z0KM TEXT:"latest in a string"] of managing directors to leave Bank of America, the United States' second-largest bank, at a time the hot M&A market is prompting other personnel moves on Wall Street. Earlier this year, Peacock was named co-head of Bank of America's newly created private capital M&A group to help private equity firms across sectors monetize their assets. Bank of America and JPMorgan declined to comment. Peacock could not be reached for comment. Earlier this month, JPMorgan said it hired former Sycamore Partners [USN:L4N45S14L TEXT:"executive Rob Sweeney"] as global chair of investment banking. He will advise major corporate clients, particularly in the consumer and retail sector, and work with senior bankers on key relationships. The bank also hired Ian Carnegie-Brown, who is based in London, from UBS this year. JPMorgan's consumer and retail investment banking team ranked No. 1 in the Dealogic industry rankings in the first six months of 2026 and for all of 2025. The bank served as financial adviser when Alimentation Couche-Tard announced plans to buy convenience store chain Zabka and when food ingredients maker Ingredion agreed to acquire rival Tate & Lyle. Bank of America lost another senior consumer and retail dealmaker over the summer when Andrew Conway [USN:L6N42H0XY TEXT:"departed"] to become Citigroup's (C.N) global chair of consumer and retail investment banking. JPMorgan has hired several prominent Bank of America bankers in recent months, including David Fishman, Amy Lissauer and Kevin Brunner. But Bank of America has said it continues to invest in talent and has hired more than 40 new managing directors in the corporate and investment bank this year.

item.title: 米ＢｏｆＡ、7─9月期はＦＩＣＣが低迷 マネロン対策12億ドル計上
item.description: [１４日 ロイター] - 米金融大手バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）が１４日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＢｏｆＡ、7─9月期はＦＩＣＣが低迷　マネロン対策12億ドル計上 10/14 23:30 配信

2026年9月8日撮影。REUTERS/Arlyn McAdorey/File Photo

[１４日 ロイター] - 米金融大手バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）が１４日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）決算は、純利益が６９億ドル（１株当たり０．９１ドル）だった。トレーディング業務の低迷が響いた。

マネーロンダリング（資金洗浄）の疑いがある取引を検知できなかったことに対する規制当局の制裁金に関連し、１２億ドルの費用計上も明らかにした。

第３・四半期の純利益は６９億ドル（１株当たり０．９１ドル）で、前年同期の８３億ドル（同１．０４ドル）から減少した。

１２億ドルの制裁金関連費用計上を除いた１株当たり利益は１．０８ドルで、ＬＳＥＧがまとめた予想の１．１０ドルを下回った。

米銀２位の同行株は８％超下落し、５月以来の安値を付けた。

セールスおよびトレーディング収入は５％減の５１億ドル。株式部門のトレーディング収入が四半期ベースで過去最高を記録したものの、債券・為替・コモディティー（ＦＩＣＣ）事業の不振がこれを打ち消した。同行は前月、四半期のセールスおよびトレーディング収入は前年比ほぼ横ばいとの見通しを示していた。

ＦＩＣＣのトレーディング収入は１７％減少した。主にモーゲージ、地方債、クレジットの低迷が響いた。

アラステア・ボースウィック最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「顧客の活動減少や、金利の大幅な変化を含む市場環境の変化が、クレジット、モーゲージ、地方債を含む当行の主力ＦＩＣＣ事業に大きな影響を与えた」と述べた。

一方、純金利収入（ＮＩＩ、融資の受取利息と預金の支払利息の差）は、融資・預金残高の増加と固定金利資産の価格見直しを背景に８％増加した。同行は、金利収入が第４・四半期に前四半期比で改善すると見込んでいる。２０２７年通期のＮＩＩの伸びは８％以上と予想している。

投資銀行業務による手数料収入は１１％減の１８億ドルとなった。同行は前月、取引活動が活発化した一部事業で十分な態勢を整えられていなかったとして、少なくとも１０％の減少を予想していた。

アラステア・ボースウィック最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「ディールメイキングを巡る環境は堅調を維持している。かなり活発な環境だ」と述べ、同行の投資銀行業務のパイプラインは厚いと強調した。

投資銀行業務の手数料は四半期ごとの変動が大きく、取引の成約時期に左右される。取引のタイミングは市場環境や規制当局の承認を受けて前後することが多い。

＜規制当局との和解に伴う費用計上＞

米財務省は１３日、ＢｏｆＡがマネーロンダリングなど不正取引の監視を適切に行わなかったとして、総額１２億１０００万ドルの制裁金を科した。

ボースウィックＣＦＯは電話による記者説明会で、同行は和解に向けて規制当局とかねてから協議を続けてきたと説明。マネーロンダリング対策を強化するため、数千人規模の人員を追加投入してきたと述べた。

アナリストらは、今回の制裁金は同行への否定的な見方を強め、費用や同意命令の継続期間を巡る懸念を高める公算が大きいと指摘した。

ブライアン・モイニハン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は在任期間について問われ、「後継者の選定は取締役会の判断だ」と応じた。モイニハン氏は２０１０年から同行のかじ取りを担っており、米大手銀行で最も長期にわたりＣＥＯを務める人物の一人となっている。

item.title: Mercados argentinos operan en baja, atención a mayor liquidez y licitación de deuda
item.description: Los negocios financieros de Argentina reportaron el miércoles caídas de precios con una expansión de circulante tras la reciente millonaria compra de dólares por parte del banco central (BCRA), previo a la primera licitación mensual de deuda por parte del Tesoro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los negocios financieros de Argentina reportaron el miércoles caídas de precios con una expansión de circulante tras la reciente millonaria compra de dólares por parte del banco central (BCRA), previo a la primera licitación mensual de deuda por parte del Tesoro. La caída también se vio afectada por una nueva alza del riesgo país sobre las 600 unidades, su máximo nivel desde inicio de octubre, y debilidad en los mercados externos por la inflación en [USN:L6N4600VI TEXT:"Estados Unidos"] con la probabilidad de alza en la tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. La autoridad monetaria absorbió 392 millones de dólares en los últimos dos días, y así superó el umbral de los 15.000 millones adquiridos en el año para respaldar sus reservas. Las compras sumaron 291 millones el martes, la mayor en casi tres mesas, y 101 millones de dólares este miércoles. En este contexto, el Tesoro tenía pendiente realizar una oferta de deuda en moneda local para enfrentar pagos de vencimiento por unos 4,9 billones de pesos (unos 3.230 millones de dólares), con la particularidad que en esta oportunidad pone a disposición títulos con amortización en el próximo mandato presidencial. El resultado con la oferta de una letra 'Lecap' (S29E7), el bono 'Bontam' (TMG28), el título dual 'CER/Tamar' (TXMD9) y el dual 'FX/Tamar' (TMVE8) se conocerá más tarde, con los mercados domésticos cerrados. "El Tesoro vuelve a ofrecer instrumentos en pesos con vencimiento luego de 2027 tras una pausa. Esperamos un 'rollover' (renovación) de alrededor del 100%, con colocaciones concentradas principalmente en la 'Lecap' de enero", comentó el agente de liquidación y compensación Max capital. El agente resaltó la fuerte intervención cambiaria del BCRA, "aparentemente mediante una operación en bloque y probablemente vinculada a la liquidación de emisiones de deuda". Ante un riesgo país ligeramente complejo en los 610 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), la bolsa de Buenos Aires cedió un 1,16% al finalizar sus negocios mediante el referencial S&P Merval (.MERV) y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles cayeron un firme 1,2% promedio ante esperadas toma de utilidades de corto alcance. El peso mayorista quedó equilibrado en la zona de los 1.513,5 por cada dólar , un día después de que se informara una inflación ([USN:ZON00GM02 TEXT:"IPC"]) del 1,9% en septiembre, desde el 1,7% de agosto, un dato que estuvo en línea a lo previsto por especialistas. Analistas no descartan que la economía argentina haya entrado en recesión en el tercer trimestre del 2026, aunque se proyecta una lenta recuperación a medida que el país se acerque a las elecciones presidenciales del 2027, según una encuesta de [USN:L6N45Y0SY TEXT:"Reuters"]. "Los indicadores de actividad de agosto mostraron señales mixtas: la industria cayó 3,2% interanual, mientras que la construcción creció 0,4% mensual, aunque retrocedió 4,4% interanual. La debilidad de las tendencias subyacentes refleja que la recuperación todavía no se consolida", reportó el Banco Patagonia. El ministro de Economía argentino, Luis Caputo, se encuentra en Tailandia por la reunión anual del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) y del Banco Mundial (BM), donde mantiene diferentes reuniones en la búsqueda de avales para refinanciar un fuerte vencimiento de deuda en 2027.

item.title: ＦＲＢ10月利上げ観測高まる、ＣＰＩ加速し広範な物価圧力示唆
item.description: ［１４日 ロイター］ - 米労働省が１４日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸びが加速したことを受け、連邦準備理...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ10月利上げ観測高まる、ＣＰＩ加速し広範な物価圧力示唆 10/14 23:24 配信

２０１２年８月撮影　REUTERS/Larry Downing

［１４日　ロイター］ - 米労働省が１４日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸びが加速したことを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今月末に開く会合での利上げ観測がやや高まった。

９月のＣＰＩは前年比３．７％上昇と、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。エコノミスト予想の３．６％も上回った。変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除くコアＣＰＩは前年比２．６％上昇。８月の２．４％から加速し、予想の２．５％も上回った。

ＦＲＢの物価目標である２％を大きく上回ったことを受け利上げ観測が高まり、短期金融市場が織り込む２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げが決定される確率は約４５％と、ＣＰＩ統計発表前の約２２％から上昇した。

インフレーション・インサイツ創業者のオマイル・シャリフ氏は「８月のＣＰＩは通信サービス料金が押し上げ要因になったが、９月の上振れの要因は特定の一項目に集中したものではなかった」と指摘。「複数の項目で上昇し、インフレ圧力が広範囲に及んでいることが示された」と述べた。

ＦＲＢ当局者は、利上げを急ぎすぎることで労働市場を不必要に冷え込ませるリスクについても考慮する必要がある。ＰＰＨＣのチーフエコノミスト、マーティン・ベック氏は、９月のＣＰＩ統計について「コアインフレ率が高止まりしていることが示され、インフレ懸念を払拭する内容ではなかった」と指摘。ただ、「雇用関連指標の弱さや消費者心理の脆弱さを踏まえると、ＦＲＢには今月の会合で金利据え置きを決定する余地は残っている」と語った。

ＣＰＩ統計発表直後に外国為替市場でドルが主要通貨に対し上昇。主要６通貨に対するドル指数は一時０．５７％高の１０２．７５と、１年６カ月ぶりの高水準を付けた。ドル／円は０．２８％高の１５８．７４円。

米国債利回りも上昇し、１０年債利回りは６．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．２８３％。ＦＲＢの政策金利見通しに連動しやすい２年債利回りは４．８９９％と、１０．６ｂｐ上昇した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に コラム：ＦＲＢが物価2.0％目指せば、利下げ開始は大幅遅延に コラム：市場の米利下げ織り込み、昨年と同様に過剰ならドル150円も＝佐々木融氏 コラム：マイナス金利解除後の政策占うＣＰＩ、上下2つのシナリオ コラム：下げ止まらない日本円の購買力、失地回復への処方箋は＝植野大作氏 最終更新: 10/14(水) 23:24 ロイター

item.title: モルガンＳ、7─9月期は利益が予想上回る 株式取引収入40％超増
item.description:
Pritam Biswas Tatiana Bautzer
[１４日 ロイター] - 米金融大手モルガン・スタンレーが...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
モルガンＳ、7─9月期は利益が予想上回る　株式取引収入40％超増 10/14 23:05 配信

米モルガン・スタンレーのロゴ。2025年12月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Pritam Biswas　Tatiana Bautzer

[１４日　ロイター] - 米金融大手モルガン・スタンレーが１４日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）決算は利益が市場予想を上回った。金利決定や米国とイランの戦闘で市場のボラティリティーが高まり、株式トレーディング業務が押し上げられたほか、アドバイザリー業務やＭ＆Ａ（企業の合併・買収）関連手数料が投資銀行部門の収益を押し上げた。

第３・四半期の株主に帰属する純利益は４９億１０００万ドル、１株当たり利益は３．０３ドル。前年同期の４６億１０００万ドル、同２．８０ドルからそれぞれ増加した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想は１株当たり２．９１ドルだった。

純収入は２０３億４０００万ドルと、前年同期の１８２億２０００万ドルから増加し、市場予想の１９９億５０００万ドルも上回った。

株式トレーディング収入は５８億ドルと、前年同期比で４１％近く増加した。ＡＪベルの市場責任者、ダニエル・コーツワース氏は「同社の株式トレーディング業務が、第３・四半期の銀行全体の業績を大きくけん引した」と述べた。

一方、債券トレーディング収入は７．３％減の２０億１０００万ドル。この減速傾向は、債券・通貨・商品（ＦＩＣＣ）部門の収入が前年比１％減少したゴールドマン・サックスの状況とも一致している。

モルガン・スタンレーのシャロン・イェシャヤ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、債券トレーディングは金利のボラティリティーの影響を受けたと説明。第３・四半期中の急激な、場合によっては予想外の金利上昇が、債券ポートフォリオを保有する投資家に影響を及ぼしたとし、「それがクレジットスプレッドの拡大を招き、在庫を保有せざるを得ない事業者にとって厳しい状況となった」と述べた。

投資銀行業務の収入は前年比２％増の２１億６０００万ドルとなった。

投資運用部門の純収入は１４億６０００万ドルと、前年同期の１６億５０００万ドルから減少した。

ウェルスマネジメント部門への純新規資産は２３２０億ドルと過去最高を更新した。ＩＰＯ（新規株式公開）関連の資金流入によるものがその半分強を占めた。イェシャヤ氏は具体的にどのＩＰＯが資金流入をもたらしたかについては明らかにしなかったが、第２・四半期に起きたものだと述べた。モルガン・スタンレーとゴールドマン・サックスは６月、イーロン・マスク氏率いる米スペースＸのＩPＯを主導した。

ウェルスマネジメント部門の純収入は、前年比１０．１％増の９０億７０００万ドルとなった。同行は第２・四半期、同部門で長年の目標であった運用資産１０兆ドルの大台を達成していた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：「ウォール街」と実体経済の温度差、ＡＩブームで一層鮮明に アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 10/14(水) 23:05 ロイター

item.title: Banks, buildings burn as Albania's capital Tirana erupts into student violence
item.description: Tens of thousands of students stormed the streets of Tirana on Wednesday, setting alight a government building and two banks and hurling stones at police during a protest over rising education costs and corruption.
item.dc:creator: Fatos Bytyci
item.content:encoded: Tens of thousands of students stormed the streets of Tirana on Wednesday, setting alight a government building and two banks and hurling stones at police during a protest over rising education costs and corruption. Police responded with water cannons and tear gas to disperse protesters who started a fire at the ministry of education building, overturned garbage cans and smashed the fronts of local businesses, Reuters footage showed. A Raiffeisen Bank branch near the education ministry also caught fire, a Reuters witness said. The protests represent the most violent outburst against Prime Minister Edi Rama, who won a fourth term in office in elections in May last year but has since faced growing discontent at [USN:L6N3ZC0BA TEXT:"perceived graft"] surrounding top officials. Protesters also dismiss opposition figures as unpalatable alternatives. The unrest caps a summer of peaceful protests against Rama, triggered by the proposed development of a [USN:L6N4380FB TEXT:"luxury resort"] along Albania's pristine southern coast backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner which has been [USN:L6N42J18T TEXT:"caught up in legal disputes"]. "This is a revolution. We are tired of peaceful protests. We will not stop until Rama resigns," said Lora, a student who declined to give her last name said as she threw rocks at the police. Others chanted "Resignation" and "Police of crime." WIDER PROTESTS Student organisers said the protest was over conditions at universities, higher education costs, a lack of financial support and employment prospects after graduation. The unrest is part of a broader wave of student activism sweeping Europe over education and living conditions. In France, high school students have staged [USN:L1N45U08J TEXT:"weeks of protests"] and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education. Albanian media reported that Wednesday's protests spread to universities at Elbasan and Shkodra. The government condemned the violence. "Protesting is a legitimate right, but it cannot be used as an excuse for violence, city destruction or ugly fighting in the middle of the road," Deputy Prime Minister Albana Kociu said on Facebook. "I call on students and every honest citizen who believes in the right to protest: Distance yourself from violence and vandalism!" The police issued a statement calling for calm. "Any person who uses violence, burns or destroys property, or attacks Police officers, bears individual responsibility and will face the law, in accordance with the offences committed," it said.

item.title: Mexico to require digital platforms to shield minors from harmful content
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said she will sign a presidential decree on Wednesday requiring digital platforms, including social media and streaming sites, to shield children and teenagers from violent, sexual and other harmful content.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said she will sign a presidential decree on Wednesday requiring digital platforms, including social media and streaming sites, to shield children and teenagers from violent, sexual and other harmful content. The decree, which will step up scrutiny of big technology companies in Latin America's second-largest economy, comes after an [USN:L6N45N12T TEXT:"attack by two 18-year-old former students on a high school"] in the northern state of Coahuila in early October left one person dead and wounded three others. Digital platforms will have one month to come into compliance with the decree, government adviser Luisa Maria Alcalde said. Sheinbaum added that if companies failed to follow the decree, the government would back a bill to penalize the platforms. Officials said they had already met with representatives of Meta (META.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Apple (AAPL.O) , TikTok, Google (GOOGL.O) , X and Huawei to discuss the matter. A Meta spokesperson told Reuters that the company, which runs Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Threads, is "aware of the decree" and that it will "analyze it in detail," adding that it has long had tools in place to help parents "guide their children's digital experience.” "We will continue to engage with the authorities to help create a safer digital environment for teenagers in the country,” the spokesperson said, adding that Meta offers safety features on its platforms which include safeguards to limit who can make contact with children, as well as the monitoring of viewed content. Microsoft, Apple, TikTok, Google, X and Huawei did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. Mexico's move follows a broader [USN:L8N42Q0MC TEXT:"global push"] to protect minors online, with governments in Europe and Australia tightening oversight of digital platforms and US states pursuing a range of child-safety measures. [USN:S0N3S10A3 TEXT:"Brazil"] has also moved to strengthen protections for children online. Such measures have raised questions over how to protect minors while safeguarding privacy and freedom of expression.

item.title: China’s funding of global development institutions rises tenfold since 2010 to $3 billion
item.description: This makes China the fifth-largest donor to the International Development Association, the World Bank’s fund for the poorest countries.
item.dc:creator: Aakriti Handa
item.content:encoded:
-->

Subscribe

Features

China’s funding of global development institutions rises tenfold since 2010 to $3 billion

This makes China the fifth-largest donor to the International Development Association, which is the World Bank’s fund for the poorest countries.

Aakriti Handa

14 October, 2026 07:07 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

New Delhi: China’s funding to development-focussed multilateral institutions increased to more than $3 billion in 2024, registering a ten-fold increase from $260 million in 2010, according to a study conducted by the Center for Global Development.

This makes China the fifth-largest donor to the International Development Association (IDA), which is the World Bank’s fund for the poorest countries, up from the 28th position it held in 2010.

China rose the ranks thanks to its latest pledge of a whopping $1.5 million to the latest replenishment. China’s funding to multilateral development banks or MDBs — that provide grants and loans on favourable terms to poorer countries — has increased by 92% over the past five years. MDBs are funded by multiple countries to finance large development projects that emerging economies may struggle to fund alone.

Show Full Article

The study, authored by Beata Cichocka and Ian Mitchell, also found a sharp increase in China’s multilateral climate-finance footprint, from $600 million in 2017 to $5.25 billion in 2025.

Although China’s contributions to the development-oriented multilaterals have grown more than tenfold since 2010, they remain highly selective. In other words, China is not uniformly amping up funding across various multilateral banks.

China’s contributions to development-oriented multilaterals, 2011–2024 | Screenshot: Center for Global Development study titled ‘China in the Multilateral Development System’ It ranks only 19th for voluntary contributions to the United Nations and contributes to just seven of the 26 vertical funds (like Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance; the Global Fund; or the Green Climate Fund). Its funding is concentrated in MDB concessional windows that provide loans on more generous terms, especially the International Development Association, and in climate finance. Hence, China remains a modest vertical fund donor and a limited voluntary UN funder.

Its overall contributions to vertical funds have fallen by 32 per cent.

More funding; less borrowing At the same time, China is borrowing less from development banks—its borrowing from MDBs has fallen nearly by half, from over $8 billion in 2021 to $4.7 billion in 2024. At the World Bank too, China has plummeted from being the largest borrower in 2017 to only the 18th largest borrower in 2025. In fact, the World Bank estimates that China will stop borrowing altogether after 2031.

China’s borrowing from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), a multilateral development bank it helped establish and is its largest shareholder, has also declined markedly since 2017.

However, China’s growing financial contribution has not led to it becoming more influential at these development banks. China’s voting power has largely remained unchanged since 2021.

Despite holding 6 per cent of the shares in the World Bank, it holds lesser voting power than the around 12 per cent implied by the Bank’s own shareholding formula.

In addition, Chinese nationals now hold fewer top UN jobs than they did five years ago, having lost leadership positions at WHO, ITU, UNIDO and WMO. Chinese nationals lead just two of the 56 development-relevant UN bodies examined and make up only 1.3 percent of the wider UN staff, despite China accounting for around 17 percent of the world’s population.

China is indeed neither withdrawing from the existing multilateral system nor simply replacing traditional Western donors within it. It is becoming more deeply embedded across a range of institutions—notably, the World Bank’s IDA and WHO—while engaging on terms that preserve its flexibility.
